<STBG 3,1><MWT 2>One day, month unknown
Fractured Isles, Guild Grand Court

<BGM 0,2000,505><TALK 3><NAME 10><CHAR 3,1,7,0,0><CV 5,1>Court is now in session.
Prosecution, are you ready?
<CHAR 3,4,7,0,0><CHAR 5,5,9,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 11><CV 10,4>No problem.

<CHAR 3,3,7,0,0><CHAR 5,6,9,0,0><TALK 3><NAME 10>Defence...
Defence!
<SLCT 2><CHC 6,Um...><CHC 10,The defence is ready>Um...

<TALK 1><NAME 1><JUMP 7>Hunter!
Are you sure you're ready?
<SLCT 2><CHC 8,No, I've no idea...><CHC 10,The defence is ready>No, I've no idea...

<TALK 1><NAME 1>Let's face reality a bit more!
Hunter!
<SLCT 1><CHC 10,...The defence is ready>...The defence is ready

<CHAR 3,5,7,0,0><CHAR 1,4,1,0,0><TALK 3><NAME 10>This court will try
the theft case.
Now, prosecution, present your case.

<CHAR 3,4,7,0,0><CHAR 5,5,9,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 11>The incident occurred the night before last,
while the victim was bathing.

Argo was confirmed walking
in the vicinity.

<CHAR 3,5,8,2,0><CHAR 5,4,9,0,0><TALK 3><NAME 9>I didn't steal anything, meow...
I was just taking a night walk, meow!

<CHAR 3,5,23,0,0><TALK 3><NAME 31>No way, that ain't so!
The one who stole my precious necklace
was you!

This necklace, y'see...
it's our family treasure that gave the hint
for the resonance crystal!
<SLCT 1><CHC 19,...Um, isn't it around your neck?>
<CHAR 3,3,23,0,0><CHAR 1,6,1,1,0><TALK 3><NAME 31><MWT 1><CV 21,8>What did you say!?

<TALK 3><NAME 10><BGM 0,1000,502>The defence has presented a new possibility:
'actually, she's wearing it right now'.

This court recognises
the need for further deliberation.

Defence,
bring evidence that 'it's being worn now'
by the next court session!

<ITEM AD_HEAD2091,0,1>Also, near the scene
gear like this seems to have been dropped.

<ITEM AD_HEAD2093,0,1>This gear can evolve and
seems to have a strong effect against
monsters near the scene.

<ITEM 0,0,0>If there are no other objections,
this court is adjourned.
<SLCT 1><CHC 29,Evidence or not, it's on right now...>Evidence or not, it's on right now...
<NAME 10>Then, the court is adjourned!

<STBG 100,2><CHAR 5,11,0,0,0><CHAR 1,11,0,0,0><STBG 2,1><CHAR 5,1,23,0,0><CHAR 1,1,1,0,0><TALK 5><NAME 31><BGM 0,2000,503>Hunter, not bad at all.
To think you'd find the possibility
that I'm wearing it right now...

I look forward to what evidence
comes out by the next court session!

<TALK 1><NAME 1>No, I just barely
hung on by a thread...
What happens next...
<SLCT 1><CHC 35,So, evidence or not...>So, evidence or not...

<TALK 5><NAME 31>For your sharpness, I'll
teach you a good thing!
<SLCT 2><CHC 37,Janet...><CHC 38,Amenoma...>

<CHAR 5,0,23,0,6><CV 21,7>Wh-who're you callin'
'Miss Janet'!?

Since I caused you trouble,
returning the favour is only natural.

Anyway, it seems the Nyan Search Corps
has found new gear again!

<ITEM WD_LANCE215,1,1>This gear in particular,
it seems to resemble the Hunter's
valiant look from a moment ago!

It seems you'll be able to use
never-before-seen martial arts!
Well then, keep it up next time!

To prove her innocence,
let's work hard gathering evidence!
<CLS>
